text:
The MGAP national forest cartography (2021 version) is the source that classifies the 2025 loss area as native forest. It reports 13.1 ha of the event area as native forest, 0.0 ha as planted forest, and 0.4 ha outside mapped forest.

The other sources don't give a forest type:
- Hansen GFC (GFC-2025-v1.13) only detects the 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025, which is 3.91% of the asset.
- JRC GFC2020 V4 shows 98% of the event area as forest in 2020, but it doesn't separate native from planted forest.

The MGAP map dates from 2021, so it describes forest type before the 2025 loss rather than after it. Also, no later year has been observed for this event, so the corroboration rule (a later year observed plus JRC agreement) isn't yet met.
